family_containment.observation: A5's family set coincides exactly with the bank's, and it never proposed the one family productive on electricity -- which is precisely the family absent from the bank

alternative_explanation_ruled_out.hypothesis: the 41% larger prompt degraded A5 mechanically
alternative_explanation_ruled_out.refuted_by: A5's envelope retry rate was LOWER (15.4% vs 20.8%), and it made more tool calls (47 vs 46) and more proposals (13 vs 12). It observed and proposed as much; only which Programs it proposed differed.

source_experience_result.relation_labels_appear_unweighted: bare repair_level_shift in the bank is 2 positive against 5 negative or immaterial, yet A5 chose it as first probe 5 times. Had the relation labels been weighed, the negative majority should have pushed away from it.
